question: Which Hockey team was the winner of first Men Hockey world cup in 1971?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first Men’s Hockey World Cup was held in **1971 in Barcelona, Spain, from October 15 to 24.**
 
• **Pakistan defeated Spain** 1-0 in the final to claim the title. 
 
• Pakistan's dominance in world hockey continued, as they went on to win the World Cup two more times: in **1978 (Buenos Aires, Argentina) and 1982 (Mumbai, India).**
 
• After the 1971 tournament, the Hockey World Cup became a** quadrennial event,** growing in stature and importance over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** The current winner of the **2023 Men's Hockey World Cup is Germany**. They secured the title by defeating Belgium in a penalty shootout after the match ended in a 3-3 draw​.
